title: Define electric potential difference

seo.title: Electric potential difference: definition — Class 10 Science

hook.scenario: Agar pipe seedha zameen par pada ho toh paani khud nahi behta. Uske pichhe pressure chahiye hota hai.
hook.question: Wire mein electrons ko dhakka (pressure) kaun deta hai?

mental_model.intuition: Potential difference wahi electrical pressure (dhakka) hai jo charge ko aage badhata hai.
mental_model.description: Bina potential difference (voltage) ke, charges flow nahi karte. Battery ya cell ek pressure difference create karta hai taaki electrons wire ke andar ek point se doosre point tak flow kar sakein.

explanation:
Physics mein, electric potential difference (jise voltage bhi kehte hain) ko us work done ke roop mein define kiya jata hai, jo ek unit charge ko ek point se doosre point tak le jaane mein lagta hai.

Iska formula V = W / Q hota hai, jahan V potential difference hai, W kiya gaya work (Joules mein) hai, aur Q charge (Coulombs mein) hai.

Iska SI unit Volt (V) hai, jo Italian physicist Alessandro Volta ke naam par rakha gaya hai. 1 Volt ka matlab hai ki 1 Coulomb charge ko move karne ke liye 1 Joule work karna pada.

Potential difference ko naapne ke liye hum voltmeter ka istemaal karte hain. Voltmeter ko hamesha un do points ke beech parallel mein connect kiya jata hai jinke beech ka voltage check karna ho.

key_points.title: Voltmeter connection
key_points.detail: Always connected in parallel across the points to be measured.

worked_example.problem: How much work is done in moving a charge of 2 C across two points having a potential difference 12 V?

steps.narration: Charge aur voltage ki values note karte hain.
Formula V = W / Q ko rearrange karte hain.
Values put karke multiply karte hain.
Work nikal lete hain, jiski unit Joule hoti hai.

worked_example.problem: A work of 100 J is done to move a 5 C charge between two points. Find the potential difference.

steps.narration: Work (W) aur Charge (Q) diya gaya hai.
Potential difference ka formula use karte hain.
Values daal kar divide karte hain.

common_mistakes.title: Connecting voltmeter in series
common_mistakes.explanation: Voltmeter ka resistance bohot zyada hota hai, isliye ise series mein lagane se current block ho jata hai. Hamesha ise parallel mein connect karein.

recall_questions.q: What is the SI unit of potential difference?
Name the device used to measure potential difference.

recall_questions.answer: The work done to move a unit charge from one point to another.

oa_questions.question: Name a device that helps to maintain a potential difference across a conductor.
oa_questions.approach: Think of what provides the 'push' for the current.
